name: Watarou
source:
The protagonist and player of the game. His role is to save a girl named Makoto, who he barely knows even as a classmate and takes on the request of Mikio to do so.

[From [url=http://charon-rpg-games.wikia.com/wiki/Makoto_Mobius]RPG games Wikia[/url]]
